label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_JuanHasManyFansDoYou
en: Do you have any?

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_YouMustBePrettyStrong
en: Oh, then you must be pretty strong.

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_LonesomeTryWorkingHarder
en: Oh, dear… That's a little lonesome.

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_LonesomeTryWorkingHarder
en: Try working a little harder to get a fan following.

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_TrainerFanClubWasWild
en: Dedicated fans come over from even outside of HOENN.

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_TrainerFanClubWasWild
en: It was really wild when I went to the TRAINER FAN CLUB in LILYCOVE.

label: Route128_Text_ArchieWhatHappened
en: ARCHIE: What happened… What is this wretched scene…

label: Route128_Text_ArchieWhatHappened
en: Did I…make a horrible mistake?

label: Route128_Text_ArchieIOnlyWanted
en: I… I only wanted…

label: Route128_Text_MaxieDoYouUnderstandNow
en: MAXIE: Do you understand now, ARCHIE?

label: Route128_Text_MaxieDoYouUnderstandNow
en: Do you finally see how disastrous your dream turned out to be?

label: Route128_Text_MaxieDoYouUnderstandNow
en: We have to hurry! We have to do something before the situation goes completely out of control!

label: Route128_Text_MaxieResposibilityFallsToArchieAndMe
en: MAXIE: {PLAYER}, don't say anything.

label: Route128_Text_MaxieResposibilityFallsToArchieAndMe
en: I know that I have no right to be critical of ARCHIE…

label: Route128_Text_MaxieResposibilityFallsToArchieAndMe
en: But the way things are now, I doubt that we humans will be capable of doing anything about it.

label: Route128_Text_MaxieResposibilityFallsToArchieAndMe
en: But neither can we stand by and just watch helplessly.

label: Route128_Text_MaxieResposibilityFallsToArchieAndMe
en: The responsibility for putting an end to this falls to ARCHIE and me…

label: Route128_Text_MaxieThisDefiesBelief
en: MAXIE: This defies belief…

label: Route128_Text_MaxieThisDefiesBelief
en: Those super-ancient POKéMON…

label: Route128_Text_MaxieThisDefiesBelief
en: Their power is unbelievable. They've upset the balance of nature…

label: Route128_Text_StevenWhatIsHappening
en: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}! What is happening?

label: Route128_Text_StevenWholeWorldWillDrown
en: This is terrible…

label: Route128_Text_StevenWholeWorldWillDrown
en: After the scorching heat wave ended, this deluge began.

label: Route128_Text_StevenWholeWorldWillDrown
en: If this doesn't stop, all of HOENN… No, the whole world will drown.

label: Route128_Text_StevenWholeWorldWillDrown
en: This huge rain cloud is spreading from above SOOTOPOLIS…

label: Route128_Text_StevenWholeWorldWillDrown
en: What in the world is taking place there?

label: Route128_Text_StevenWholeWorldWillDrown
en: There's no point arguing here… SOOTOPOLIS might provide answers…

label: Route128_Text_StevenImGoingToSootopolis
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}… I don't know what you intend to do, but don't do anything reckless.

label: Route128_Text_StevenImGoingToSootopolis
en: Okay. I'm going to SOOTOPOLIS.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_OurNewHomeLetsGoInside
en: MOM: {PLAYER}, we're here, honey!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_OurNewHomeLetsGoInside
en: It must be tiring riding with our things in the moving truck.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_OurNewHomeLetsGoInside
en: Well, this is LITTLEROOT TOWN.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_OurNewHomeLetsGoInside
en: How do you like it? This is our new home!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_OurNewHomeLetsGoInside
en: It has a quaint feel, but it seems to be an easy place to live, don't you think?

label: LittlerootTown_Text_OurNewHomeLetsGoInside
en: And, you get your own room, {PLAYER}! Let's go inside.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_WaitPlayer
en: MOM: Wait, {PLAYER}!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_WearTheseRunningShoes
en: MOM: {PLAYER}! {PLAYER}! Did you introduce yourself to PROF. BIRCH?

label: LittlerootTown_Text_WearTheseRunningShoes
en: Oh! What an adorable POKéMON! You got it from PROF. BIRCH. How nice!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_WearTheseRunningShoes
en: You're your father's child, all right. You look good together with POKéMON!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_WearTheseRunningShoes
en: Here, honey! If you're going out on an adventure, wear these RUNNING SHOES.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_WearTheseRunningShoes
en: They'll put a zip in your step!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_SwitchShoesWithRunningShoes
en: {PLAYER} switched shoes with the RUNNING SHOES.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ExplainRunningShoes
en: MOM: {PLAYER}, those shoes came with instructions.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ExplainRunningShoes
en: “Press the B Button while wearing these RUNNING SHOES to run extra-fast!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ExplainRunningShoes
en: “Slip on these RUNNING SHOES and race in the great outdoors!”

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ComeHomeIfAnythingHappens
en: To think that you have your very own POKéMON now… Your father will be overjoyed.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ComeHomeIfAnythingHappens
en: …But please be careful. If anything happens, you can come home.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ComeHomeIfAnythingHappens
en: Go on, go get them, honey!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanUsePCToStoreItems
en: If you use a PC, you can store items and POKéMON.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanUsePCToStoreItems
en: The power of science is staggering!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSpendsDaysInLab
en: PROF. BIRCH spends days in his LAB studying, then he'll suddenly go out in the wild to do more research…

label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSpendsDaysInLab
en: When does PROF. BIRCH spend time at home?

label: LittlerootTown_Text_IfYouGoInGrassPokemonWillJumpOut
en: Um, um, um!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_IfYouGoInGrassPokemonWillJumpOut
en: If you go outside and go in the grass, wild POKéMON will jump out!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_DangerousIfYouDontHavePokemon
en: It's dangerous if you don't have your own POKéMON.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanYouGoSeeWhatsHappening
en: Um, hi!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanYouGoSeeWhatsHappening
en: There are scary POKéMON outside! I can hear their cries!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanYouGoSeeWhatsHappening
en: I want to go see what's going on, but I don't have any POKéMON…

label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanYouGoSeeWhatsHappening
en: Can you go see what's happening for me?

label: LittlerootTown_Text_YouSavedBirch
en: You saved PROF. BIRCH! I'm so glad!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_GoodLuckCatchingPokemon
en: Are you going to catch POKéMON? Good luck!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_TownSign
en: LITTLEROOT TOWN “A town that can't be shaded any hue.”

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ProfBirchsLab
en: PROF. BIRCH'S POKéMON LAB

label: LittlerootTown_Text_PlayersHouse
en: {PLAYER}'s HOUSE

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ProfBirchsHouse
en: PROF. BIRCH'S HOUSE

label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSomethingToShowYouAtLab
en: PROF. BIRCH: Well, well, {PLAYER}{KUN}! That was good work out there!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSomethingToShowYouAtLab
en: I knew there was something special about you when I first saw you, but I never expected this.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSomethingToShowYouAtLab
en: Oh, yes. Do you still have the POKéDEX I gave you?

label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSomethingToShowYouAtLab
en: I have something to show you. Let's go to my LAB.

en: Your partner has retired.

en: Your BATTLE ROOM challenge will be canceled.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WhereIsWally
en: Where has our WALLY gone?

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WhereIsWally
en: We have to leave for VERDANTURF TOWN very soon…

label: PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouRookieTrainer
en: Hiya! Are you maybe… A rookie TRAINER?

label: PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouRookieTrainer
en: Do you know what POKéMON TRAINERS do when they reach a new town?

label: PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouRookieTrainer
en: They first check what kind of GYM is in the town.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_ThisIsPetalburgGym
en: See? This is PETALBURG CITY's GYM.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_ThisIsGymSign
en: This is the GYM's sign. Look for it whenever you're looking for a GYM.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WaterReflection
en: My face is reflected in the water.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WaterReflection
en: It's a shining grin full of hope…

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WaterReflection
en: Or it could be a look of somber silence struggling with fear…

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WaterReflection
en: What do you see reflected in your face?

label: PetalburgCity_Text_FullPartyExplanation
en: Let's say you have six POKéMON. If you catch another one…

label: PetalburgCity_Text_FullPartyExplanation
en: It is automatically sent to a STORAGE BOX over a PC connection.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_GymSign
en: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM LEADER: NORMAN “A man in pursuit of power!”

label: PetalburgCity_Text_CitySign
en: PETALBURG CITY “Where people mingle with nature.”

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WallyHouseSign
en: WALLY'S HOUSE

label: PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouATrainer
en: Excuse me!

label: PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouATrainer
en: Let me guess, from the way you're dressed, are you a POKéMON TRAINER?

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WellMaybeNot
en: Well, maybe not. Your clothes aren't all that dirty.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WellMaybeNot
en: You're either a rookie TRAINER, or maybe you're just an ordinary kid.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_ImLookingForTalentedTrainers
en: I'm roaming the land in search of talented TRAINERS.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_ImLookingForTalentedTrainers
en: I'm sorry to have taken your time.

label: FortreeCity_DecorationShop_Text_MerchandiseSentToPC
en: Merchandise you buy here is sent to your own PC.

label: FortreeCity_DecorationShop_Text_MerchandiseSentToPC
en: That's fantastic! I wish they could also deliver me home like that.

label: FortreeCity_DecorationShop_Text_BuyingDeskForDolls
en: I'm buying a pretty desk and I'm putting my cute DOLLS on it.

label: FortreeCity_DecorationShop_Text_BuyingDeskForDolls
en: If I don't, when I decorate my SECRET BASE, my DOLLS will get dirty or poked with splinters.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaIntro
en: I'll show you the sublime techniques I learned from our LEADER JUAN!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaDefeat
en: Please forgive me, JUAN…

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaPostBattle
en: Watch what happens if you crack all the floor tiles.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyIntro
en: You came all the way here, but you won't get to see JUAN.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyIntro
en: Not if you lose to me, you won't!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyDefeat
en: You're strong! I was fooled by your cute looks!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyPostBattle
en: You might be good enough to avoid being wiped out in one hit by JUAN.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphneIntro
en: The sight of JUAN conducting a battle…

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphneIntro
en: The very beauty of it compelled me to become a TRAINER.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphneDefeat
en: You battled with more beauty than I could muster…

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphnePostBattle
en: The grace you bring to battle is fabulous.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphnePostBattle
en: Oh… I'm so fortunate to have found POKéMON.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConnieIntro
en: I should teach you how harsh battles can be.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConnieDefeat
en: Oh. You're strong.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConniePostBattle
en: I'll tell you something good.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConniePostBattle
en: If you want to reach JUAN, you need to walk on each floor tile once.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetIntro
en: The POKéMON GYM of the highest level in the HOENN region…

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetIntro
en: That's the SOOTOPOLIS GYM.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetDefeat
en: What a high level you are!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetPostBattle
en: Rather than being satisfied by being in a strong GYM, I imagine training in other places will make you stronger. But above all, it looks more fun.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaIntro
en: I train my POKéMON together with JUAN.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaIntro
en: Don't think I'm a pushover.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaDefeat
en: I was beaten…

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaPostBattle
en: I think you have potential. Why don't you stay and train with us?

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyIntro
en: A graceful glide across the ice while crossing no lines…

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyIntro
en: A TRAINER putting on that performance would be elegantly beautiful!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyDefeat
en: Well, excuse me?!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyPostBattle
en: This is really obvious, but how strong you are as a TRAINER has nothing to do with how young or old you are.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyIntro
en: When I'm with my POKéMON, the time flies by before you can say, “Oops!”

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyDefeat
en: Oops!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyPostBattle
en: I wish I could forget about lost causes before I can manage an “Oops!”

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaIntro
en: I can battle with really rare POKéMON if you'd like.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaDefeat
en: Oh, there now! Did you have a good look at my POKéMON?

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaPostBattle
en: I came to this GYM because JUAN praised me for my darling POKéMON.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaPostBattle
en: Oh, if only I'd met JUAN years ago when I was younger…

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaIntro
en: Giggle… Your grim look is so charming.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaDefeat
en: Oh, dear. I went much too easy on you.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaPostBattle
en: You couldn't lay a finger on JUAN, I'm sure. Giggle…

label: LilycoveCity_House1_Text_PokemonPartnersNotTools
en: POKéMON are partners to people. They aren't our tools.

label: LilycoveCity_House1_Text_PokemonPartnersNotTools
en: Unfortunately, there are some people who fail to understand that…

label: LilycoveCity_House1_Text_Kecleon
en: KECLEON: Ruroro?

label: SkyPillar_Top_Text_RayquazaFlewOff
en: The awakened RAYQUAZA flew off…

label: OldaleTown_House2_Text_PokemonLevelUp
en: When POKéMON battle, they eventually level up and become stronger.

label: OldaleTown_House2_Text_YoullGoFurtherWithStrongPokemon
en: If the POKéMON with you become stronger, you'll be able to go farther away from here.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleArena
en: Where the battling spirit of TRAINERS is put to the test!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleArena
en: I welcome you to the BATTLE ARENA!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleArena
en: I am your guide to the Set KO Tourney!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WishToTakeChallenge
en: Now, do you wish to take the BATTLE ARENA challenge?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_AwaitAnotherChallenge
en: We await your challenge on another occasion!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: In the BATTLE ARENA, we undertake the Set KO Tourney.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: All participants enter with a team of three POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: The three POKéMON must be lined up in the order in which they are to appear.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: During battle, the POKéMON will appear one at a time in the preset order.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: Once a POKéMON enters battle, it must remain out until the match is decided.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: If a match remains undecided in three turns, it goes to judging.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: If you wish to interrupt your challenge, please save the game.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: If you don't save, you will not be able to continue with your challenge.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: If you pull off the feat of beating seven TRAINERS in succession, we will present you with Battle Points.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_OkayToSave
en: Before showing you to the BATTLE ARENA, you must save. Is that okay?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode
en: The BATTLE ARENA offers two levels of challenge, Level 50 and Open Level. Which is your choice?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_SelectThreeMons
en: Very well, now select your three POKéMON, please.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: My dear challenger!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: You do not have the three POKéMON required for entry.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: To qualify, you must bring three different kinds of POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: They also must not hold the same kinds of items.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: EGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: When you have made your preparations, please do return.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: My dear challenger!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: You do not have the three POKéMON required for entry.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: To qualify, you must bring three different kinds of POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: The three different POKéMON must all be Level 50 or lower.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: They also must not hold the same kinds of items.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: EGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: When you have made your preparations, please do return.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_GuideYouToArena
en: I shall now guide you to the BATTLE ARENA.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeShuttingDown
en: My dear challenger!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeShuttingDown
en: You did not save the game before shutting down, did you?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeShuttingDown
en: It is unfortunate, but that has resulted in your disqualification from your challenge.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeShuttingDown
en: You may, of course, start with a fresh challenge.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_CongratsOnSevenWins
en: We congratulate you for your splendid string of wins over seven TRAINERS!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_RecordAchievement
en: Your achievement will be recorded. Please wait while I save the game.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_PresentYouWithPrize
en: In commemoration of your 7-win streak, we present you with this prize.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ReceivedPrize
en: {PLAYER} received the prize {STR_VAR_1}.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_BagFullReturnForPrize
en: Oh? Your BAG seems to be full.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_BagFullReturnForPrize
en: I urge you to clear space and return for your prize.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ThankYouWaitWhileSave
en: Thank you so much for participating!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ThankYouWaitWhileSave
en: Please wait while I save the game.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_AwaitAnotherChallenge2
en: We await your challenge on another occasion!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_LookingForwardToArrivalSaveGame
en: We have been looking forward to your arrival.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_LookingForwardToArrivalSaveGame
en: Before I show you to the BATTLE ARENA, I must save the game. Please wait.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_RecordLastMatch
en: Shall I record your last BATTLE ARENA match on your FRONTIER PASS?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_BadIdeaToNotAttack
en: I lost on the REFEREE's decision…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_BadIdeaToNotAttack
en: I don't think it was a good idea to only use defensive moves and not attack…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_LandingHitsWorked
en: I won in judging!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_LandingHitsWorked
en: Landing hits consistently on the opponent's POKéMON worked!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_MatchWasDeclaredDraw
en: Our match was declared a draw.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_MatchWasDeclaredDraw
en: When we ran out of time, both my POKéMON and the opponent's had about the same amount of HP left.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_OrderOfMonsImportant
en: In the BATTLE ARENA, the order of POKéMON is totally important.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_OrderOfMonsImportant
en: For example, if your first POKéMON has certain type disadvantages, try making your second POKéMON one with moves that are super effective against the first one.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBattleRules
en: The Set KO Tourney has special rules, unlike standard battles.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBattleRules
en: First, one battle lasts only three turns.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBattleRules
en: If the outcome is not decided after three turns, it goes to judging.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBattleRules
en: The REFEREE will choose the winner based on how the POKéMON battled.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBattleRules
en: Also, a POKéMON cannot be switched out until its battle's outcome is decided.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainMindRules
en: The first judging factor is “Mind.” This factor evaluates how aggressive the battlers were.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainMindRules
en: The judging is based on how often the TRAINERS ordered the use of offensive moves.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainSkillRules
en: The second judging factor is “Skill.” This factor evaluates how effectively POKéMON moves were used.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainSkillRules
en: If a move worked successfully, the Skill rating goes up.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainSkillRules
en: If a move failed, the Skill rating is lowered.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainSkillRules
en: If it was an offensive move, the Skill rating goes up if the move was “super effective” and goes down if it was “not very effective.”

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainSkillRules
en: The Skill rating will not go up for moves such as PROTECT and DETECT.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainSkillRules
en: If the opponent used PROTECT or DETECT, and your POKéMON failed to hit with a move, its Skill rating will not go down.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBodyRules
en: The third judging factor is “Body.” This factor is based on how much HP remained at the end of a battle.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBodyRules
en: The rating takes into account how much HP a POKéMON had at the start of battle, and what remained at the end.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
en: You're… Ah, you must be {PLAYER}{KUN}, right?

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
en: Thank you for playing with WALLY a little while ago.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
en: He's been frail and sickly ever since he was a baby.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
en: We've sent him to stay with my relatives in VERDANTURF TOWN for a while.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
en: The air is a lot cleaner there than it is here.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
en: What's that? Where's WALLY? He's already left, our WALLY.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
en: I wonder where he could have gotten by now?

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WonderHowWallyIsDoing
en: I wonder how our WALLY is doing?

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Please excuse us for dragging you here this way.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
en: But our WALLY's become very healthy since he went to VERDANTURF TOWN.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
en: We owe it all to you!

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
en: When WALLY left town, you helped him catch a POKéMON, right?

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
en: I think that made WALLY really happy.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
en: Actually, not just WALLY. It made me, his father, happy too.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
en: Happy that he's gained such a great friend as you.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
en: This isn't a bribe or anything, but I'd really like you to have this.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_SurfGoAllSortsOfPlaces
en: If your POKéMON can SURF, you'll be able to go to all sorts of places.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyIsComingHomeSoon
en: WALLY's coming home soon. I'm looking forward to that.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_YouMetWallyInEverGrandeCity
en: Oh? You met WALLY in EVER GRANDE CITY?

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_YouMetWallyInEverGrandeCity
en: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}, don't be silly.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_YouMetWallyInEverGrandeCity
en: He may have gotten healthy, but he can't go somewhere far away like that all by himself.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyWasReallyHappy
en: WALLY was really happy when he told us that he caught a POKéMON.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyWasReallyHappy
en: It's been ages since I've seen him smile like that.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyLeftWithoutTelling
en: I want you to keep this a secret from my husband…

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyLeftWithoutTelling
en: But our WALLY left VERDANTURF TOWN without telling anyone.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyLeftWithoutTelling
en: You know, WALLY is frail, but he's surprisingly strong-willed.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyLeftWithoutTelling
en: I'm sure that he'll come back safe and sound one day!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: WALLACE: Welcome, {PLAYER}{KUN}.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: That incident in SOOTOPOLIS CITY… That was superb work, putting an end to that crisis all by yourself.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: Oops!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: It wouldn't be fair to say that you alone ended the crisis.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: You overcame that difficult situation by working as one with your POKéMON.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: We TRAINERS raise POKéMON by giving them items and by teaching them new techniques for battle.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: But we ourselves also learn many things from POKéMON.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: And this is where your achievements are put to the test against what others like you have achieved.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: Now!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: Who can most elegantly dance with their POKéMON in HOENN?

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: Show me right here and now!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_Defeat
en: I, the CHAMPION, fall in defeat…

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_Defeat
en: That was wonderful work. You were elegant, infuriatingly so. And yet it was utterly glorious!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_Defeat
en: Kudos to you, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_Defeat
en: You are a truly noble POKéMON TRAINER!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: WALLACE: The POKéMON you sent into battle…

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: At times they danced like a spring breeze, and at times they struck like lightning.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: It was with light, yet surefooted, elegance that you led your POKéMON.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: Even I felt bedazzled by your masterful performance!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: You now stand at the glorious peak of the POKéMON LEAGUE.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: I now proclaim you to be the new HOENN region…

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayAdvice
en: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayAdvice
en: Here's some advice before you challenge the CHAMPION…

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayItsAlreadyOver
en: MAY: Huh? What, what, what?

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayItsAlreadyOver
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}… Could it be that… It's already over?

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BrendanAdvice
en: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BrendanAdvice
en: How would you like some advice before you challenge the CHAMPION?…

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BrendanYouveWon
en: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}…

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BrendanYouveWon
en: Are you trying to tell me… You've beaten the CHAMPION?

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchArriveRatePokedex
en: PROF. BIRCH: See? What did I tell you, {RIVAL}?

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchArriveRatePokedex
en: Didn't I tell you that you don't need to worry about {PLAYER}{KUN}?

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchArriveRatePokedex
en: … … … … … … … … {PLAYER}{KUN}, you've finally done it.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchArriveRatePokedex
en: When I heard that you defeated your own father at the PETALBURG GYM, I thought perhaps you had a chance…

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchArriveRatePokedex
en: But to think you've actually become the CHAMPION!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchArriveRatePokedex
en: Ah, yes!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchArriveRatePokedex
en: What became of your POKéDEX? Here, let me see.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchCongratulations
en: PROF. BIRCH: Anyways, congratulations!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchCongratulations
en: Now, go proudly into the final room!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_WallaceComeWithMe
en: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}…

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_WallaceComeWithMe
en: No, let me rephrase that properly.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_WallaceComeWithMe
en: The new CHAMPION!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_WallaceComeWithMe
en: Come with me.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_WallaceWaitOutside
en: WALLACE: I'm sorry, but…

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_WallaceWaitOutside
en: From here on, only those TRAINERS who have become CHAMPIONS may enter.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_WallaceWaitOutside
en: You'll have to wait outside with PROF. BIRCH.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayCongratulations
en: MAY: Groan…

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayCongratulations
en: I'm just joking! That's okay! That's the rule!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayCongratulations
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Honestly, congratulations!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BrendanCongratulations
en: BRENDAN: Whaaaat?! … … … … … … … … … … … … …

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BrendanCongratulations
en: It can't be helped if that's the rule.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BrendanCongratulations
en: {PLAYER}, way to go! Congratulations!

en: Er-hem!

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_ChairmansYoungerBrotherOnVacation
en: I am the POKéMON FAN CLUB's most important person, the CHAIRMAN's younger brother.

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_ChairmansYoungerBrotherOnVacation

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Yo, how's it going, CHAMPION-bound {PLAYER}?

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: The GYM LEADERS here use PSYCHIC-type POKéMON.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: If you go up against them with FIGHTING- or POISON-type POKéMON, they'll inflict horrible damage!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Plus, they'll come at you with outstanding combination attacks.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: If you want to win, you'll need to show them how tight you are with your POKéMON. Go for it!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
en: Wow, you're astounding! You're one great TRAINER!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonIntro
en: Battles hinge on the strength of your spirit! The weak-spirited will never win!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonDefeat
en: I lost! I must temper my spirit again!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonPostBattle
en: The indecisive lose. That's my warning to you.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_VirgilIntro
en: Let me see your talent!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_VirgilDefeat
en: You possess spectacular talent!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_VirgilPostBattle
en: If there are prodigies in the world, then our GYM LEADERS are them!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_VirgilPostBattle
en: However, you may be even more talented than them…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakeIntro
en: Fufufufu… Watch me levitate a POKé BALL telekinetically!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakeIntro
en: Wrooooooooaaaar! … … … … … … …

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakeIntro
en: Sometimes, I'm out of sync…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakeDefeat
en: My POKéMON battling skills are out of sync, too!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakePostBattle
en: A POKé BALL was too heavy to lift psychically. But this dust bunny…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakePostBattle
en: Whoooooooooooooooh! … … … … … …

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakePostBattle
en: No, I'm not cheating! I didn't blow on it! Honestly!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahIntro
en: When you lose to me, don't be too hard on yourself.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahIntro
en: It's not that you're weak--I'm just too strong!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahDefeat
en: You're just too strong!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahPostBattle
en: I'm not going to get down on myself for losing. I just need to train harder.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahPostBattle
en: Positive thinking--that's my strong point!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaIntro
en: I see it… I see your future…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaIntro
en: If you can beat me, I will tell you your future!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaDefeat
en: I surrender!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaPostBattle
en: You will wage a terrifically intense battle with our GYM LEADERS…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaPostBattle
en: The result… You won't hear it from me!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraIntro
en: The roads you have traveled… What you have experienced…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraIntro
en: Come at me with everything you've learned!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraDefeat
en: You've traveled a path of greatness!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraPostBattle
en: A bright future awaits those who have worked diligently.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraPostBattle
en: For those who lazed idly, there is only despair at the end.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraPostBattle
en: What goes around comes around…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaIntro
en: Even at the risk of life, I will win this battle!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaDefeat
en: What you do… It horrifies me…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaPostBattle
en: How dare you beat me…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaPostBattle
en: It won't be my fault if something horrible befalls you…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NateIntro
en: Hohoho.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NateIntro
en: You need me to show you how tenacious the PSYCHIC type can be.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NateDefeat
en: Oh! My, my! Your battle style is fantastic!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NatePostBattle
en: I… I don't let defeat rattle m-me, however b-badly.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_KathleenIntro
en: Let me show you a perfectly awful, horrifying time!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_KathleenDefeat
en: N-nooooo!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_KathleenPostBattle

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_GotToGoBackForSootopolis
en: Everything is in your hands now. Don't fail us!

label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_NormanBecameGymLeader
en: NORMAN became our town's new GYM LEADER.

label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_NormanBecameGymLeader
en: I think he called his family over from somewhere far away.

label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_BattledNormanOnce
en: I battled NORMAN once, but, whew, he was way too strong.

label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_BattledNormanOnce
en: How would I put it?

label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_BattledNormanOnce
en: I just got the feeling that he lives for POKéMON.

en: Welcome to LILYCOVE DEPARTMENT STORE.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_IBuyAllSortsOfThings
en: Whenever I come to the DEPARTMENT STORE, I always end up buying all sorts of things because it's so fun.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_MomBuyingMeFurniture
en: Today, my mom is going to buy me some nice furniture.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_BuyingSomethingForAzumarill
en: I'm buying something for my AZUMARILL as a reward for winning a CONTEST.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_Azumarill

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_WirelessCommIsFun
en: Wireless Communication is a lot of fun, isn't it?

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_WirelessCommIsFun
en: I think it lets you do things that weren't possible before.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_WirelessCommIsFun
en: For instance, you can now trade with people you couldn't before.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_WirelessCommIsFun
en: I think it's going to be exciting!

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_SpreadWordAboutWirelessComm
en: I want to spread the word about how fun Wireless Communication can be.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EverythingClutteredKeepThis
en: LANETTE: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EverythingClutteredKeepThis
en: I'm sorry everything is so cluttered… When I get engrossed in research, things end up this way…

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EverythingClutteredKeepThis
en: This is embarrassing… Please keep this a secret in exchange for this.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_OrganizeYourBoxes
en: May I offer advice about my POKéMON Storage System?

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_OrganizeYourBoxes
en: You should organize your BOXES so you can tell which POKéMON are in them.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage1
en: It's LANETTE's research notes. There's information about BOXES.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage1
en: Design BOXES to hold 30 POKéMON each.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage1
en: Each TRAINER should be able to store 420 POKéMON on the PC system.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage1
en: Keep reading?

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage2
en: A marking system should be added to make POKéMON easier to organize.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage2
en: The name and wallpaper design of each BOX will be made changeable to please the stored POKéMON.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage2
en: Keep reading?

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage3
en: When storing a POKéMON, it should be sent to the BOX inspected last.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage3
en: If that BOX is full, the received POKéMON is stored in the next BOX.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage3
en: In other words, when a BOX is examined, it is automatically selected as the BOX to which POKéMON are sent.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ClosedTheNotebook
en: {PLAYER} closed the notebook.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EmailFromBill
en: There's an e-mail from someone on the PC.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EmailFromBill
en: “Your Storage System offers more convenience than mine.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EmailFromBill
en: “It has a lot of user-friendly features that make it fun and useful, too.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EmailFromBill
en: “It makes me proud that I played a part in its development.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EmailFromBill
en: “Here's hoping that you'll continue research in Storage Systems.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EmailFromBill
en: “From BILL … … … … … … … …”

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_BrotherLikesToFindBases
en: My little brother says he likes to go find people's SECRET BASES.

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_BrotherLikesToVisitBasesAndBattle
en: My little brother says he likes to visit people's SECRET BASES and have POKéMON battles.

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_YouMadeSecretBaseNearX
en: Was it you who made a SECRET BASE near {STR_VAR_1}?

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_MakeSecretBase
en: You should make a SECRET BASE somewhere. I'll go find it!

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_Skitty
en: SKITTY: Miyaan?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_AdviceForContests
en: Want a tasty little bit of advice for CONTESTS?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_AdviceForContests
en: Using a certain move after another certain kind of move sometimes gets you extra attention.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_AdviceForContests
en: If you know what you're doing, you can score big in appeal.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_AdviceForContests
en: Of course, your opponents might try disrupting your POKéMON's showing.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MyPapaIsContestJudge
en: My papa, he's a CONTEST JUDGE.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MyPapaIsContestJudge
en: I wonder what I should be when I grow up, a JUDGE or a GYM LEADER?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ImLikeMajorlyCheesed
en: Hey, man, I'm like majorly cheesed, you know. Like, you know, I just wanted to know why my POKéMON never won, you know, like, hey?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ImLikeMajorlyCheesed
en: So, like, I gave the JUDGE my two cents, you know, they're free.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ImLikeMajorlyCheesed
en: And he wouldn't hear me out, like, hey! So, like, total bummer, man!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ImLikeMajorlyCheesed
en: Hey, like, you! Zip it, you know? Just, you know, take this!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ExplainTorment
en: That's, like, TM41, you know? Hey, it's TORMENT, you hearing me?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ExplainTorment
en: Like, it won't let the other guy use the same move twice in a row, see?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ExplainTorment
en: Hey, now, you listen here, like, I'm not laying a torment on you!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MCStepUpTakePartInContest
en: MC: Oh, my, my! Now isn't that a dandy of a POKéMON?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MCStepUpTakePartInContest
en: Please! Do step right up and take part in our splendid CONTESTS!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MCStepUpTakePartInContest
en: You'll do well! I'm sure of it! My eyes have never failed me!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_JudgeWouldntDoToMissContest
en: JUDGE: Well, hello there! I see that you're a TRAINER!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_JudgeWouldntDoToMissContest
en: Then, it just wouldn't do for you to miss a POKéMON CONTEST!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_JudgeWouldntDoToMissContest
en: Get a CONTEST PASS in VERDANTURF CITY and enter anytime!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ItsAppealTime
en: It's appeal time! What should I lead with?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_DidntPayAttentionToAppeal
en: They didn't pay much attention to my POKéMON's appeal…

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_DidntPayAttentionToAppeal
en: Humph, that JUDGE, he doesn't know a good thing when he sees it.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_RewardWithSageAdvice
en: Oh, hi! You must be a serious fan to get this close to the action.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_RewardWithSageAdvice
en: I'll reward your enthusiasm with this sage advice.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_RewardWithSageAdvice
en: If a move goes over really well, the audience will get excited.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_RewardWithSageAdvice
en: The POKéMON that makes its appeal right when everyone's excited…

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_RewardWithSageAdvice
en: Well, you'd think something good has to happen!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MoreFreakedOutThanMon
en: I can't do this! I'm more freaked out than my POKéMON.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MoreFreakedOutThanMon
en: I'm shivering and my heart is racing!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_BattleAndContestAlike
en: A battle and a CONTEST aren't the same, but they are alike, too.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_BattleAndContestAlike
en: You need to work hard and believe in the POKéMON you've raised.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MonLooksOnTopOfGame
en: That POKéMON looks like it's on top of its game, huh?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MonLooksOnTopOfGame
en: A POKéMON that does good in the secondary judging seems to be more relaxed when it's doing appeals.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MyMonBetterThanThatLot
en: Will you look at that sorry sight?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MyMonBetterThanThatLot
en: Heh, my POKéMON's absolutely better than that lot!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_GetUrgeToMoveWithMon
en: Don't you get the urge to move with POKéMON if they're putting on an energetic appeal?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_HyperRankStage
en: POKéMON CONTESTS HYPER RANK STAGE!

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LanetteGreeting
en: Oh, hello. You are?

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LanetteGreeting
en: Okay, your name's {PLAYER}{KUN}. I can see that you're a TRAINER.

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LanetteGreeting
en: So that means you use the POKéMON Storage System I developed.

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LanetteGreeting
en: How I arrived at that conclusion is a simple deductive process.

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LanetteGreeting
en: You spoke to me because you wanted to access something on this PC.

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LanetteGreeting
en: Oh, I'm sorry. I'm LANETTE.

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LanetteGreeting
en: Honestly, I'm glad to meet you--it's great you're using the Storage System.

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LanetteGreeting
en: If you could, please visit me at home. My house is on ROUTE 114.

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FossilManiacEdgeOfTown
en: I wonder what POKéMON looked like long, long ago?

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FossilManiacEdgeOfTown
en: Maybe the FOSSIL MANIAC at the edge of town will know.

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PlantHardyTrees
en: In the fields of FALLARBOR, we plant seedlings of hardy trees that thrive even in volcanic ash.

label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_BuyingHealsInCaseOfShroomish
en: I'm buying some PARLYZ HEALS and ANTIDOTES.

label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_BuyingHealsInCaseOfShroomish
en: Just in case I run into SHROOMISH in PETALBURG WOODS.

label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_ShouldBuySuperPotionsInstead
en: My POKéMON evolved. It has a lot of HP now.

label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_ShouldBuySuperPotionsInstead
en: I should buy SUPER POTIONS for it instead of ordinary POTIONS.

label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_GettingEscapeRopeJustInCase
en: I'm getting an ESCAPE ROPE just in case I get lost in a cave.

label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_GettingEscapeRopeJustInCase
en: I just need to use it to get back to the entrance.

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_B1F_Text_PerfectPlaceToGoExploring
en: This is a perfect place to go exploring! It's exciting here!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_B1F_Text_PerfectPlaceToGoExploring
en: I bet there're amazing treasures on board.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_TodayWonSmartnessContest
en: This POKéMON won the BEAUTY CONTEST here before.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_TodayWonSmartnessContest
en: Well, guess what? Today, I made it win a SMARTNESS CONTEST!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_TodayWonSmartnessContest
en: My abilities scare even me…

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredBunchOfContests
en: I've entered a bunch of CONTESTS, so I'm seeing how things work.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredBunchOfContests
en: If you're in a COOLNESS CONTEST, cool moves go over as appeals.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredBunchOfContests
en: But smart moves and cute moves don't go over well, for instance.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ManWhoWonEarlierHadPokeblocks
en: That young man who won earlier had a whole bunch of different {POKEBLOCK}S.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ManWhoWonEarlierHadPokeblocks
en: Can you win if you had that many of those things?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_IsntThisPlaceHumongous
en: Whoa, isn't this place humongous!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_IsntThisPlaceHumongous
en: The tension in the air… It's not like a CONTEST hall in the sticks.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_GiveItBestSmartAppeal
en: MC: Okay, SMART POKéMON and their TRAINERS, are you ready?!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_GiveItBestSmartAppeal
en: Give it your best showing! Let's appeal!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AreYouEnjoyingThisContest
en: JUDGE: Are you enjoying this CONTEST?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AreYouEnjoyingThisContest
en: Come back with three friends, and all of you may enter a CONTEST!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredWrongContest
en: Ayayayay… I entered the wrong CONTEST.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredWrongContest
en: I entered this tough POKéMON in the SMARTNESS CONTEST…

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredWrongContest
en: Come on, wow them with a smart-looking ROCK SMASH.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_RaisedMonToBeSmart
en: I've spent many a year, and all my wisdom besides, raising this POKéMON to be smart.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_RaisedMonToBeSmart
en: It won't be easily bested by some young pup's POKéMON.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_RaisedMonToBeSmart
en: My dear wife, are you seeing this?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_IfMonPullsSmartMoveNext
en: There it is!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_IfMonPullsSmartMoveNext
en: If my POKéMON pulls a smart move next, the audience's excitement will peak!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_DontAppreciateCuteLeechLife
en: Oh, dear, no!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_DontAppreciateCuteLeechLife
en: My darling ZUBAT's LEECH LIFE is so cute I kept using it over and over!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_DontAppreciateCuteLeechLife
en: But these mean people don't appreciate it at all!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_YoureBeautifulGrandpa
en: Kiyaaah! You're beautiful, Grandpa!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AllSeemToUseDifferentMoves
en: Even when TRAINERS enter the same kind of POKéMON, they all seem to use different moves for appeals.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AllSeemToUseDifferentMoves
en: It's just like the way people have different styles for battling.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PokemonSmarterThanTrainers
en: I think the POKéMON look smarter than their TRAINERS. By a lot.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_StillLoveSmartnessContests
en: When all's said and done, I still love SMARTNESS CONTESTS.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_StillLoveSmartnessContests
en: That intellectual green color… It's so… So… Cool.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AreYouEnteringBeautyContest
en: MC: Are you entering the BEAUTY CONTEST, too? Good luck!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EveryPokemonPristineBeauty
en: JUDGE: Ah, every POKéMON here is a model of pristine beauty!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EveryPokemonPristineBeauty
en: Why, I almost forgot to score them!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EyesWillBeGluedToMyBeauty
en: A POKéMON this beautiful… There isn't another one like it.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EyesWillBeGluedToMyBeauty
en: Everyone's eyes will be glued to my beauty.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_OverdidGrooming
en: Waaaah!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_OverdidGrooming
en: I brushed and groomed my POKéMON carefully for this CONTEST…

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_OverdidGrooming
en: But I overdid it… My POKéMON's coat turned all scraggly…

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_OverdidGrooming
en: What should I do?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_JudgeWontSeeAuroraBeam
en: This AURORA BEAM is so dazzling, the JUDGE won't be able to see it.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_JudgeWontSeeAuroraBeam
en: Uh, wait a second… That'll be meaningless, then!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PokemonLooksLikeYoungerMe
en: This pretty POKéMON looks just like me when I was younger.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PokemonLooksLikeYoungerMe
en: Right when I said that, my husband spewed the coffee he was drinking.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PokemonLooksLikeYoungerMe
en: Did I say something funny?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_WinBeautyContestMakesMeHappy
en: You know, if I win at a BEAUTY CONTEST, sure it makes me happy. More than usual, anyway.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_GanderAtAllThosePrettyPokemon
en: Wahahahah!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_GanderAtAllThosePrettyPokemon
en: Will you take a gander at all those pretty POKéMON! I just love this sort of glitz!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_CantWinOnBeautyAlone
en: You can't always win on just beauty alone.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_CantWinOnBeautyAlone
en: You have to groom your POKéMON so it's nice and glossy like mine.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_InTheMiddleOfContest
en: MC: Uh-oh! Hello! We're in the middle of a CONTEST!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_InTheMiddleOfContest
en: Please enter at our registration counter and come out, okay?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_SuchCharmingCuteAppeals
en: JUDGE: Oh, such charming and cute appeals!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_SuchCharmingCuteAppeals
en: Oh, my goodness! What a perfectly adorable WATER SPORT appeal!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyAzurillWasDistracted
en: Oh, no… My sweet AZURILL was distracted by another POKéMON.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_NeverWonBattleButContest
en: My POKéMON has never won in a battle, but put it in a CONTEST and look out!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PetalDanceIsMarvel
en: My POKéMON's PETAL DANCE is a marvel of elegance.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PetalDanceIsMarvel
en: I won't let anyone disturb its performance.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyMonAppealSoMuchCuter
en: Everyone's POKéMON are very cute.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyMonAppealSoMuchCuter

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainPoison

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToInstallDoors
en: It took me all night to install the doors…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToInstallDoors
en: You're almost my equal in greatness!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightSettingUpArrows
en: It took me all night setting up arrows…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightSettingUpArrows
en: You're my equal in greatness!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightPolishingFloors
en: It took me all night polishing floors…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightPolishingFloors
en: You're above me in greatness! Possibly…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_FountainOfIdeasRunDry
en: Wh-what should I do? My fountain of ideas for tricks has run dry…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_FountainOfIdeasRunDry
en: Perhaps it is time I toured the country on a quest to devise new tricks…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_DefeatedMePreferWhichTent
en: I hate to admit defeat, but you have bested me!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_DefeatedMePreferWhichTent
en: Still, you must have been reeled in by my charisma for you to visit me again and again. Yes, you must have!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_DefeatedMePreferWhichTent
en: But that has nothing to do with my losing!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_DefeatedMePreferWhichTent
en: In recognition of the friendship between you, the driven, and the genius that is myself, I demand that you take this keepsake!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_DefeatedMePreferWhichTent
en: Actually there are two-a RED TENT and a BLUE TENT. Which do you prefer?

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_NoRoomInPC
en: What? No room in your PC? What am I to make of that?

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_NoRoomInPC
en: I wish I could say that, but I am much too kind and caring, so come back later!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_LeavingOnJourney
en: I am leaving on a journey of discovery. A quest in search of new tricks.

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_LeavingOnJourney
en: I wish that you will one day visit and entertain me again.

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_LeavingOnJourney
en: And now, farewell!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_YouHaveEarnedThisReward
en: Fine! You have earned this reward!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_NoRoomForThis
en: What? Have you no room for this? What manner of items do you carry?

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_NoRoomForThis
en: But fine, since you've reached me, your reward will be with me till later.

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_MakeNewTricksToStumpYou
en: Scrub that smug smirk from your face! It's much too early to think you've won!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_MakeNewTricksToStumpYou
en: I'll make new tricks to stump you, I will. You may mock me only when you're done.

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_MakeNewTricksToStumpYou
en: Come back for the next exciting installment!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_YoureIgnoringMe
en: Now, now! You're ignoring me now? Now that, I consider heartbreaking!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt3Intro
en: Who are you? Where did you come in from?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt3Defeat
en: Lost it…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
en: I can't find the way out!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
en: I'm not afraid. Don't get me wrong!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt4Intro
en: Who are you? Where do you think you're going?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt4Defeat
en: I failed to win!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
en: My partner forgot the map in that submarine!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
en: How's that for being useless?

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_B1F_Text_GettingQueasy
en: Urrrrppp…

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_B1F_Text_GettingQueasy
en: I'm getting queasy just being aboard this ship…

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_B1F_Text_GettingQueasy
en: It's not even moving, but…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyIntro
en: Ahahahaha!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyIntro
en: How did you manage to get here without a submarine? What an impressive child!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyIntro
en: But… It won't do to have you meddling about here.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyIntro
en: And, I do want payback for what happened at the WEATHER INSTITUTE…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyIntro
en: I'm going to give you a little taste of pain! Resign yourself to it!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyDefeat
en: Ahahahaha!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyDefeat
en: Ouch!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyPostBattle
en: Ahahahaha! You're so darn strong.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyPostBattle
en: It's terribly disappointing that you're not a TEAM AQUA member.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyPostBattle
en: You could have enjoyed the fabulous world our BOSS has promised as one of us…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5Intro
en: For our dream to become real, we need the power of POKéMON.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5Intro
en: But meddlers like you use the power of POKéMON to mess with us even at a place like this!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5Intro
en: Life just doesn't work the way we need it to!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5Defeat
en: Gwah!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
en: You know, we don't dare question the motives of our leader.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
en: But here you are, just some punk, going up against our BOSS.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
en: Maybe… You must be something…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_RocketLaunchImminent
en: The rocket's launch is imminent!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_SuccessfulLaunchNumber
en: The rocket launched safely! That's successful launch no. {STR_VAR_1}!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_HaywireButRocketLaunchImminent
en: I know that things are a little haywire right now, but…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_HaywireButRocketLaunchImminent
en: The rocket's launch is imminent!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_HaywireButSuccessfulLaunchNumber
en: I know that things are a little haywire right now, but…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_HaywireButSuccessfulLaunchNumber
en: The rocket launched safely! That's successful launch no. {STR_VAR_1}!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_RocketLaunchDemandsPerfection
en: A rocket launch demands perfection. Not even a 1% margin of error is allowed.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_RocketLaunchDemandsPerfection
en: Even if it's 99% okay, the whole thing is useless if 1% happens to be no good.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_RocketLaunchDemandsPerfection
en: Despite that, we never stop trying. Why? It's a dream that never ends.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaHaveSightsOnSpaceCenter
en: Those MAGMA thugs have their sights set on our SPACE CENTER.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaHaveSightsOnSpaceCenter
en: But we can't allow anything that minor to interfere with our rocket launch!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_FoundThisYouCanHaveIt
en: I was taking a stroll down the beach when I found this.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_FoundThisYouCanHaveIt
en: It's not anything I need, so you can have it.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_HoennFamousForMeteorShowers
en: The HOENN region has been famous for its meteor showers for a long time.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaCantStealFuelTakeThis
en: TEAM MAGMA can't be allowed to steal the rocket fuel.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaCantStealFuelTakeThis
en: Oh, by the way, you can have this stone I found on the beach.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_CantStrollOnBeachWithMagma
en: With TEAM MAGMA around, I guess strolls on the beach aren't safe.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_DidPokemonComeFromSpace
en: Some people claim that POKéMON came from space. Could it be true?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_AquaShouldBeatMagma
en: TEAM AQUA should take care of TEAM MAGMA!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_AquaShouldBeatMagma
en: But if they did that, TEAM AQUA will become bold and brazen, won't they?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_RocketsBoggleMyMind
en: A giant chunk of metal bursts through the skies and flies into space…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_RocketsBoggleMyMind
en: It boggles my mind!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaWantsToSpoilMyDream
en: A giant chunk of metal bursts through the skies and flies into space…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaWantsToSpoilMyDream
en: But TEAM MAGMA wants to spoil that dream of mine!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaWantsToSpoilMyDream
en: I'm not having any of that!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_StevenMagmaCantBeAllowedToTakeFuel
en: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, have you read that proclamation already?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_StevenMagmaCantBeAllowedToTakeFuel
en: TEAM MAGMA is coming after the rocket fuel on this island.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_StevenMagmaCantBeAllowedToTakeFuel
en: I don't know what they'd need it for, but they can't be allowed to take it.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_StevenMagmaCantBeAllowedToTakeFuel
en: I'll keep an eye on things for a while longer.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_StevenMagmaCantBeAllowedToTakeFuel
en: In the meantime, why don't you go check out the town?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt3Intro
en: As promised, we've come for the rocket fuel!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
en: Ran out of fuel…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
en: Don't think you're on a roll just because you've beaten me!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt1Intro
en: We gave you fair warning! There's nothing sneaky about us!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
en: Grrr… We should've used sneaky treachery…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
en: Okay, I get it already! The next time, we'll come unannounced.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4Intro
en: The rocket fuel the SPACE CENTER has in storage--that's what we're after.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4Intro
en: We mean to take every last bit of it!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4Defeat
en: Please, can you spare some fuel? Even a chintzy cup will do!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
en: What are we going to do with the rocket fuel?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
en: How would I know? Ask our leader upstairs!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt2Intro
en: Our leader said no one, but no one, gets past me!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
en: Ack! Ack! Aaack!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: Please, tell our leader that I never abandoned my post. That I stayed to the bitter end…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaIntentToStealNotice
en: This is… An intent-to-steal notice?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaIntentToStealNotice
en: “To the staff of the SPACE CENTER: How are you? We are doing fine.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaIntentToStealNotice
en: “We will soon visit you to take your rocket fuel.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaIntentToStealNotice
en: “Please don't try to stop us. We will take the fuel no matter what.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaIntentToStealNotice
en: “Let there be more land! TEAM MAGMA”

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WelcomeForSingleBattle
en: Where the hearts of TRAINERS are put to the test.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WelcomeForSingleBattle
en: I welcome you to the BATTLE PALACE.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WelcomeForSingleBattle
en: I accept challenges to the SINGLE BATTLE HALLS.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_TakeSingleBattleChallenge
en: Do you wish to take the SINGLE BATTLE HALL challenge?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainSingleBattleChallenge
en: In the BATTLE PALACE, there are several auditoriums for SINGLE BATTLES that are named SINGLE BATTLE HALLS.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainSingleBattleChallenge
en: The SINGLE BATTLES are conducted in the usual way, except with one crucial rule that must be obeyed.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainSingleBattleChallenge
en: TRAINERS are permitted only to switch their POKéMON in and out.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainSingleBattleChallenge
en: TRAINERS are otherwise forbidden to command their POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainSingleBattleChallenge
en: The POKéMON are to behave according to their nature and battle on their own.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainSingleBattleChallenge
en: You must put your trust in your POKéMON and watch over them.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainSingleBattleChallenge
en: If you achieve the honor of beating seven TRAINERS in succession, we will present you with Battle Points.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainSingleBattleChallenge
en: If you want to interrupt your challenge, you must save the game.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainSingleBattleChallenge
en: If you don't save before interrupting, you will be disqualified.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ReturnWhenFortified
en: When you have fortified your heart and POKéMON, you must return.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WhichChallenge
en: There are two BATTLE HALLS, Level 50 and Open Level. Which is your choice of a challenge?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: Sigh…

en: To enter, you must provide three different kinds of POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: These POKéMON must all be of Level 50 or lower.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: They also must not be holding the same kinds of items.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FollowMe
en: Good. Now, follow me.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ResultsWillBeRecorded
en: I feel privileged for having seen your POKéMON's exploits.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ResultsWillBeRecorded

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FirmTrueBondsFor7WinStreak
en: To achieve a 7-win streak…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FirmTrueBondsFor7WinStreak
en: The bonds that bind your heart with your POKéMON seem firm and true.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FeatWillBeRecorded
en: Your feat will be recorded. I must ask you to briefly wait.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_BattlePointsFor7WinStreak
en: For the feat of your 7-win streak, we present you with Battle Point(s).

en: {PLAYER} received the prize {STR_VAR_1}.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LadyCanTellWhatMonsThink
en: For a hardy fellow like me, hardy POKéMON are the best.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LadyCanTellWhatMonsThink
en: Offense is the best defense! A relentless attack is the ultimate!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LadyCanTellWhatMonsThink
en: But that's not what I wanted to chat about.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LadyCanTellWhatMonsThink
en: Every so often a really cute lady swings by here.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LadyCanTellWhatMonsThink
en: She says that she can tell what POKéMON are thinking.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LadyCanTellWhatMonsThink
en: I don't know about that part, but she is really cute.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LadyCanTellWhatMonsThink
en: Huh? Why are you looking at me like that?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NatureAndMovesKeyHere
en: Hmm…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NatureAndMovesKeyHere
en: It appears that the nature of POKéMON and the moves that they have been taught are the keys to battle here.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NatureAndMovesKeyHere
en: To be more precise, it's how well the moves match the nature of the POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NatureAndMovesKeyHere
en: If your POKéMON is in trouble and unable to live up to its potential, you may need to examine how well its moves match its nature.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_MonDocileButTransforms
en: My POKéMON is usually very docile.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_MonDocileButTransforms
en: But when it's in a BATTLE HALL, it sometimes seems to become transformed into something wicked!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_MonDocileButTransforms
en: It becomes totally intimidating. It's shocking, even.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WhatNatureFavorsChippingAway
en: I wonder what sort of nature a POKéMON would have if it favored enfeebling its opponents and chipping away slowly.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WhatNatureFavorsChippingAway
en: I'd be surprised if it was a LAX nature.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WhatNatureFavorsChippingAway
en: But, nah, that can't be right.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WelcomeForDoubleBattle
en: Where the hearts of TRAINERS are put to the test.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WelcomeForDoubleBattle
en: I welcome you to the BATTLE PALACE.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WelcomeForDoubleBattle
en: I accept challenges to the DOUBLE BATTLE HALLS.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_TakeDoubleBattleChallenge
en: Do you wish to take the DOUBLE BATTLE HALL challenge?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainDoubleBattleChallenge
en: In the BATTLE PALACE, there are several auditoriums for DOUBLE BATTLES that are named DOUBLE BATTLE HALLS.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainDoubleBattleChallenge
en: The DOUBLE BATTLES are conducted in the usual way, except with one crucial rule that must be obeyed.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainDoubleBattleChallenge
en: TRAINERS are permitted only to switch their POKéMON in and out.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainDoubleBattleChallenge
en: TRAINERS are otherwise forbidden to command their POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainDoubleBattleChallenge
en: The POKéMON are to behave according to their nature and battle on their own.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainDoubleBattleChallenge
en: You must put your trust in your POKéMON and watch over them.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainDoubleBattleChallenge
en: If you achieve the honor of beating seven TRAINERS in succession, we will present you with Battle Points.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainDoubleBattleChallenge
en: If you want to interrupt your challenge, please save the game.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainDoubleBattleChallenge
en: If you don't save before interrupting, you will be disqualified.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ToDefeatMavenAnd7Trainers
en: To defeat the PALACE MAVEN and seven TRAINERS in a row…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_PresentYouWithBattlePoints
en: In honor of the bond you share with your POKéMON, we present you with these Battle Point(s).

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LikeToRecordMatch
en: Would you like to record your latest BATTLE PALACE match on your FRONTIER PASS?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
en: The BATTLE HALL rules are listed.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
en: Which heading do you want to read?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesBasics
en: Here, POKéMON are required to think and battle by themselves.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesBasics
en: Unlike in the wild, POKéMON that live with people behave differently depending on their nature.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesNature
en: Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may prefer to attack no matter what.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesNature
en: Another POKéMON may prefer to protect itself from any harm.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesNature
en: Yet another may enjoy vexing or confounding its foes.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesNature
en: Due to its nature, a POKéMON will have favorite moves that it is good at using.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesNature
en: It may also dislike certain moves that it has trouble using.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesMoves
en: There are offensive moves that inflict direct damage on the foe.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesMoves
en: There are defensive moves that are used to prepare for enemy attacks or used to heal HP and so on.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesMoves
en: There are also other somewhat-odd moves that may enfeeble the foes with stat problems including poison and paralysis.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesMoves
en: POKéMON will consider using moves in these three categories.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesUnderpowered
en: When not under command by its TRAINER, a POKéMON may be unable to effectively use certain moves.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesUnderpowered
en: A POKéMON is not good at using any move that it dislikes.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesUnderpowered
en: If a POKéMON only knows moves that do not match its nature, it will often be unable to live up to its potential.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesWhenInDanger
en: Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may start using moves that don't match its nature when it is in trouble.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesWhenInDanger
en: If a POKéMON begins behaving oddly in a pinch, watch it carefully.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_NeedKnowledgeOfMonsMoves
en: Hi! You, there!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_NeedKnowledgeOfMonsMoves
en: Are you thinking that the events here are easy since you don't need to have a raised team of POKéMON?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_NeedKnowledgeOfMonsMoves
en: I wouldn't be too sure about winning that easily.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_NeedKnowledgeOfMonsMoves
en: If you don't have thorough knowledge about POKéMON and their moves, it will be tough to keep winning.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_SwappedForWeakMon
